title: Broncos vs. Rams: How to watch this Sunday's NFL game
seoTitle: Broncos vs. Rams: How to watch Sunday's NFL game
subtitle: Week 3 regular season game will be broadcast on DAZN
excerpt: Denver hosts Los Angeles this Sunday, September 27, at 9:20 PM BRT. Find out where to watch, key players, and absences for each team.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The Denver Broncos and Los Angeles Rams face off this Sunday, September 27, at 9:20 PM (Brasília time), marking the first Sunday Night Football of the season at Empower Field at Mile High. The matchup is highlighted as the third week of the NFL regular season.

Where to watch the matchup live

NFL Game Pass, available on the DAZN platform, is the official way to watch the game. The "Season Pro Ultimate" package guarantees access to the live game, NFL Redzone, and NFL Network, without requiring a regular DAZN subscription.

Game time and location

The matchup will be played at Empower Field at Mile High in Denver, Colorado, scheduled to start at 9:20 PM (Brasília time). This will be the first Sunday Night Football held at the Broncos' stadium.

Team performance in the opening weeks

The Broncos arrive with one win and one loss (1-1). In Week 2, they defeated the Jacksonville Jaguars 20-13, with quarterback Bo Nix leading the comeback in the final minutes. Meanwhile, the Rams also hold a 1-1 record after losing to the San Francisco 49ers in their opener and defeating the New York Giants 28-6, highlighted by quarterback Matthew Stafford, who racked up 482 yards and four touchdowns in the first two games.

Key players and confirmed absences

For the Broncos, running back Jonah Coleman was placed on injured reserve following an ankle injury, sidelining him for at least three games. Marvin Mims Jr. has a foot issue, but RJ Harvey and J.K. Dobbins fully participated in practice.

For the Rams, wide receiver Puka Nacua was listed as questionable due to hip and groin issues. Still, Stafford has Davante Adams, who already has 221 receiving yards and two touchdowns in the first two games of the season.

How to secure the broadcast abroad

Fans who are outside Brazil may need to use a virtual private network (VPN), such as NordVPN, to securely access DAZN's streaming.

With information from Goal.com, www.sportingnews.com.
